ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping district symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 22-H in the area bounded by

A line 59.10 feet north of and parallel to West 90th Street; the alley next east of and

parallel to South Western Avenue; West 90th Street; and South Western Avenue.

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 8957-59 S Western Ave. Chicago, IL 60643
